verdict.rationale: Cloudflare (the platform Registrar is part of) has a documented official MCP server at developers.cloudflare.com/agent-setup/, but the evidence pack does not show Registrar-specific tools or actions exposed through that MCP server, only a general platform-level mention. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Registrar domain-management/API functions are exposed via the MCP server, and independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent using it for registrar tasks.
